query: 为了年度盘点，请帮我查看：食品饮料在3月和5月的销量对比
expected_sql: SELECT d.month,SUM(o.order_quantity) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id=d.date_id WHERE p.category='食品饮料' AND d.month IN (3,5) GROUP BY d.month
expected_sql_alternatives: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.month=3 THEN o.order_quantity ELSE 0 END),SUM(CASE WHEN d.month=5 THEN o.order_quantity ELSE 0 END) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id=d.date_id WHERE p.category='食品饮料' AND d.month IN (3,5)
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  d.month,
  SUM(f.order_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = '食品饮料'
  AND d.month IN (3, 5)
GROUP BY d.month
ORDER BY d.month;
